fast.type: Sunnah fast · Ayyamul Bidh (white days) day 2
fast.why: Today is the 14th, the second white day. Next: the 15th (Wed 25 Nov). Niyyah before Subuh (Shafi'i); if you missed it, a sunnah fast can still be intended before Zuhur if you haven't eaten.

blessing: Your free time and health, even the small pockets. Today, spend five minutes of it on something that benefits your deen and say 'Alhamdulillah' for your health.

verse.text: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.

hadith.text: The Prophet ﷺ said: "There are two blessings which many people lose: health and free time."

lesson.title: Fiqh of solat: tuma'ninah
lesson.text: In the Shafi'i school, tuma'ninah (a brief stillness in each pillar, ruku', i'tidal, sujud, sitting between sujud) is itself a pillar of solat. The Prophet ﷺ told the man who prayed hastily to 'return and pray, for you have not prayed' (Bukhari 757). Even on busy days, slow down so each pillar settles.

name.text: "He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection (As-Salam)" (59:23). Ask Him for peace of heart before your day starts.
"Indeed, our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative (Shakur)" (35:34). He rewards even small deeds; end today with one thank-you.

world.text: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists set it at 85 seconds to midnight on 27 Jan 2026, the closest ever, citing nuclear risk, AI and great-power rivalry.
Forecasters' chance of a 'World War Three' before 2050 (10M+ deaths, major powers involved).
Prof Jiang's latest lectures on geopolitics and where great-power conflict is heading.

Nuclear deterrence makes all-out war a losing move for every major power, so the stable outcome (flashing) is 'compete, don't fight': trade wars, arms races and proxy conflicts. The real danger is a misread in a crisis like Taiwan or Ukraine, which is why the clock and the forecast are rising. Meter: 2 of 5.
